2020 Q2.gq: Our outlook for the Manufacturing Support segment is unchanged from May, with high single-digit organic revenue growth.
2020 Q2.bq: Organic revenue growth of 1.4% exceeded our prior outlook of mid-single digit decline because client demand has been resilient, and the impact of COVID-19 has been less severe than originally anticipated.

2020 Q3.gq: With respect to our full year 2020 guidance, as Jim mentioned, we are increasing our revenue growth outlook to a range of 5% to 6% on an organic basis and 9.5% to 10.5% on a reported basis, reflecting the third quarter performance.
2020 Q3.bq: The accelerated RMS recovery was a key component of our robust third quarter financial results, which exceeded our expectations.

2020 Q4.bq: In 2020, free cash flow was $380 million, an increase of 12% from 2019, but below our prior guidance.

2021 Q1.gq: And one of the reasons why we've been able to increase our outlook this year is because we can see much more of the year.

2021 Q2.gq: Our outlook for DSA is unchanged, with low double-digit organic revenue growth for the full year, reflecting continued strength in early-stage research activity.
2021 Q2.bq: This result widely exceeded our prior outlook of more than 50% in earnings growth for the quarter, primarily as a result of the exceptional demand environment.

2021 Q3.gq: We now expect a 150 to 200 basis point basis from FX for the year compared to our prior outlook of approximately 250 basis points.

2021 Q4.bq: We exceeded our prior guidance range of $10.20 to $10.30 and reported a second consecutive year with earnings growth above the 20% level.

2022 Q1.gq: The reported revenue growth outlook for this segment is being increased to a high-single-digit range to include the Explora revenue contribution.

2022 Q3.bq: Our solid financial performance was highlighted by a 15.3% organic revenue growth and non-GAAP earnings per share of $2.63, both of which exceeded our prior outlook.

2022 Q4.bq: The revenue growth rate exceeded the top end of our guidance range by 140 basis points driven primarily by outperformance in both the Discovery and Safety Assessment businesses.

2023 Q1.gq: And we reaffirmed our guidance of low to mid-single digits for the year.
2023 Q1.bq: We delivered strong organic revenue growth of 15.4%, wildly outperforming our prior expectations.

2023 Q3.gq: The guidance update is primarily due to shifts in the gating of our forecast between quarters and the favorable impact of lower third quarter cancellations in the Safety Assessment business being largely offset by a reduced outlook for our Manufacturing Solutions segment in the fourth quarter.
2023 Q3.bq: We reported third quarter organic revenue growth of 4.1% and earnings per share of $2.72, both of which exceeded our prior outlook.

2024 Q2.gq: As Jim discussed in detail, we have significantly lowered our guidance for the full year and now expect a revenue decline of 2.5% to 4.5% on a reported basis and 3% to 5% on an organic basis, driven primarily by a softer demand outlook in the second half of the year than previously anticipated for both small and midsized biotechnology and global pharmaceutical clients.
2024 Q2.bq: Earnings per share of $2.80 increased 4.1% year-over-year and exceeded the implied outlook in our prior guidance by approximately $0.40.

2024 Q3.bq: DSA revenue modestly exceeded our prior outlook of a 10% second half decline, because global biopharma demand trends held up better than we expected.

2024 Q4.bq: We are pleased to end the year with a fourth-quarter performance that was slightly better than expected, yielding annual revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share higher than the guidance that we issued in November.

2025 Q1.gq: Our Manufacturing outlook is unchanged on an organic basis.
2025 Q1.bq: Our first quarter revenue performance was above our February outlook for a mid-single-digit decline due primarily to the DSA segment's performance, for which I will provide more details shortly.

2025 Q3.gq: The CDMO business, as well as biologics testing, are also driving a slightly less favorable outlook for the segment, as we now expect manufacturing revenue to be flat to slightly lower on an organic basis this year, compared to our prior outlook of approximately flat.
2025 Q3.bq: Earnings per share were $2.43 in the third quarter, a 6.2% decline from the third quarter of last year, but modestly above our prior outlook.

2026 Q2.gq: I'm pleased to report that we delivered on our second quarter financial targets, exceeding our prior outlook for the quarter and that we are raising our financial guidance for the year.
2026 Q2.bq: Non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.02 increased 47% sequentially, which was well above our prior outlook of at least 30% sequential growth.

2026 Q3.bq: We are pleased today to report another solid quarter with revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share that exceeded our prior outlook, continued momentum in the improving biopharmaceutical demand environment, and additional progress towards the execution of our Pathway to Purpose strategic vision.
